pages.text: Carry a $(item)Rock Catalyst$() in your inventory. When you pick up a rock with a known conversion, the catalyst absorbs it and returns the mapped output for each set of four.$(br2)Outputs go into your inventory, or drop beside you if they do not fit. Existing inventory rocks are not automatically vacuumed in.

pages.title: Buffer and Emptying
pages.text: The catalyst keeps fewer than four leftover rocks per output type in its item NBT. Rocks mapping to the same output share that buffer.$(br2)Its tooltip shows progress. Sneak-right-click to drop the buffered progress back as matching rocks. Use JEI for the catalyst’s acquisition recipe in the current pack.
